title: 2025北京马拉松鸣枪开跑 3.2万名选手同场竞技（澎湃新闻·中国城市报）
claims: The 2025 field was 32,000 runners, a record high at the time; the race kept the classic line while making multi-dimensional route refinements.
The organisers extended the North 4th Ring auxiliary-road section to ease congestion and reduced the number of second-half turnaround points to one, improving running fluency.
The 2025 route incorporated landmarks including the National Speed Skating Oval (Ice Ribbon) and Aolin East Road to present the city's dual-Olympic heritage.
Men's winner Hayle ran 2:08:10 and Chinese runner Li Dalin was the domestic men's first in 2:11:26; women's winner Genaneh ran 2:26:08 and Huang Xuemei was the domestic women's first in 2:31:28.
